name: Temple Gold
description: Ivory page with maroon bands, a gold gopuram arch, kolam knots and carved temple doors that swing open.

name: Mango Leaf & Marigold
description: Festive thoranam garlands of mango leaves and marigolds, and a rice-flour kolam that draws itself.

name: Kanjivaram Silk
description: Peacock teal and magenta silk with woven gold zari borders, temple-border bands and paisley motifs.

name: Kerala Kasavu
description: Airy ivory and kasavu gold stripes, a nilavilakku lamp and jasmine strings. Calm and refined.

name: Blush Botanical
description: Soft watercolor blush and sage, line-art roses, script names and a wax-sealed envelope intro.

name: Midnight Art Deco
description: Navy and gold Gatsby glamour with sunburst gates, stepped frames and deco countdown tiles.

name: Modern Editorial
description: Fashion-magazine minimalism: oversized serif type, an asymmetric grid and one terracotta accent.

name: Henna Mandala
description: Mehendi line-work in henna and saffron around a slowly turning mandala that blooms open.

name: Celestial Night
description: Twinkling indigo sky, a crescent moon, a constellation of the couple's initials and a moon-phase countdown.

name: Vintage Postcard
description: Airmail stripes, a perforated stamp, postmarks, ticket-style events and handwritten wish notes.

name: Thoranam Housewarming
description: Mango-leaf and marigold thoranam over the door and a kolam at the threshold, for a Gruhapravesam.

name: Paal Pongum
description: Light the stove and the milk boils over a brass pot. Athangudi tiles, a Pillaiyar suzhi, a tiled photo frame and palm-leaf blessings. Tamil-first.

name: Blueprint
description: For a house you built: the plans unroll and the house draws itself. A drafting title block, room-plan events and a dimension-line countdown.

name: Home Lights
description: Tap the house at dusk and its windows and fairy lights switch on. A pegged polaroid, little-house events and an Edison-bulb countdown.

name: Going Up
description: For a new flat: press the lift button, the brass dial climbs and the doors slide open. Apartment-door events, letterboxes and a notice board.

name: Twinkle Little Star
description: A soft night sky, a crescent moon and the birthday star's initial in the stars.

name: Sprinkle Cake
description: Blow out the candle on a two-tier cake. Drip icing, a party-hat photo frame and a macaron countdown, for little ones.

name: Level Up
description: An 8-bit game: PRESS START dissolves into pixels, a game HUD, coin-popping ? blocks, a stage select and high-score wishes.

name: Neon Nights
description: Flip the light switch and a neon sign flickers on over a brick wall, with a photo-booth strip. For teens and grown-ups.

name: Web Hero
description: A superhero comic book: break free of a giant web, a comic-cover hero, mission-briefing events and speech-bubble wishes.

name: Goggles & Bananas
description: Yellow and denim: peel a banana to open, the child's photo in a giant goggle, overall-pocket events and a goggle countdown.

name: Little Boss
description: The baby is the CEO: open the briefcase, an APPROVED memo, a meeting agenda, a flip clock and 'While you were out' wishes.

name: Glass Slipper
description: A fairy-tale royal ball: the clock strikes twelve, a glass slipper, a silver portrait frame and filigree programme cards.

name: Rainbow Unicorn
description: Tap the golden horn and a rainbow sweeps in: a gold-foil title, an original unicorn, iridescent cards and a cloud countdown.

name: Monster Trainer
description: A mystery egg hatches into a trainer adventure: a holo trainer card, events as trading cards, badges and dialogue-box wishes.

name: Vel Muruga
description: With Lord Murugan's blessings: a peacock feather fans into a tail, a golden Vel (or your Murugan picture) and Tamil-first headings.

name: Valaikappu
description: The traditional Tamil bangle ceremony: tap the glass bangles, a jasmine garland and the mother-to-be's photo in a wreath of bangles. Tamil-first.

name: Little Sprout
description: A little one is growing: water the seed and it sprouts. Watercolour leaves, an arched photo window and seed-packet events.

name: Special Delivery
description: A stork brings the bundle and guests tap to unwrap it. Shipping-label events, a tracking-timeline countdown and gift-tag wishes.

name: Oh Baby
description: A boho balloon garland with pearl OH BABY letters: let the balloons fly. Earthy tones, arch frames and a balloon countdown.

name: Sweet Dreams
description: A felt nursery mobile that turns when guests wind the music box. Stitched felt cards, a cloud photo frame and a lullaby feel.

name: Ring Box
description: Emerald velvet and champagne gold: open the ring box and the solitaire rises. An emerald-cut photo setting, jeweller's-certificate events and a faceted-gem countdown.

name: Thamboolam
description: The two families exchange thamboolam plates and the lagna pathrikai unrolls. A turmeric-dabbed card, a betel-leaf photo frame and drawstring-bag events. Tamil-first.

name: Peony Bloom
description: Moody wine-dark florals: tap the bud and a peony blooms around the couple's initials. A gilded oval photo frame, botanical-plate events and pressed-flower wishes.

name: It's a Yes!
description: Big news in bright colours: tick Yes and the card flips to a confetti YES! A sticker-badge photo frame, chunky colour cards and a tear-off calendar countdown.

name: Golden Hour
description: A seashore at sunset: tap the sun and it sinks as the couple join hands. The photo is the setting sun, events sit on the sand and wishes arrive as messages in bottles.

name: Marigold Mela
description: Tap the bowl of haldi: turmeric handprints stamp the screen and a brush sweeps it gold. A canopy of swaying umbrellas, a marigold-wreath photo frame, events hung on marigold strings and a brass-urli countdown.

name: Haldi Groove
description: 70s retro: drop the needle and a haldi-yellow record spins up the music. An album-sleeve photo, cassette-tape events, a daisy countdown and dedications from an ON AIR request line.

name: Phool Chadar
description: Pastel lemon, sage and blush: tap to lift a sheer embroidered dupatta. A canopy of flowers with hanging strands, an oval photo frame with flower clusters, embroidery-hoop countdown and stitched wishes.

name: The Haldi Times
description: A newspaper special edition: the front page spins in with the headline "to turn yellow!" A yellow-printed lead photo, a news ticker, clip-out events and letters to the editor.

name: Petal Pool
description: A pool haldi in turquoise and yellow: tap the water and dive in. The photo floats in a pool ring, events sit on the pool deck, a pool-ring countdown and wishes as paper boats.
